The test image shows banana fruits with dark circular lesions progressing over time (Days 1-10 post inoculation). Lesions start small and dark brown/black, expanding and becoming highly moldy. This is on banana fruit peel, not leaves.

Key features: dark sunken circular spots on fruit surface, progressive enlargement, mold development.

Now let me view reference images one per class, starting with the most likely candidates.
Anthracnose reference: banana fruits with dark irregular spots/streaks on yellow peel. Matches the fruit lesion pattern partially. Let me check other classes.
Cigar End Rot: dark necrosis at the tip/blossom end of banana fingers. Does NOT match - test image shows circular spots on the body of the fruit, not tip rot.
Bunchy Top: stunted plant with bunched leaves - clearly a whole plant disease. Does NOT match - completely different from fruit lesions in test image.
Cordana Leaf Spot: oval lesion with yellow halo on a leaf. Leaf disease, does NOT match the fruit spots in test image.
Panama Disease: yellowed/wilting leaves with brown streaks. Leaf/vascular disease, does NOT match the fruit lesion pattern.

Yellow and Black Sigatoka: oval lesions with yellow halos on leaves. Leaf disease, does NOT match.

Summary so far: 6 classes checked. Only **Anthracnose** shows dark spots on banana fruit, which matches the test image. All other classes affect leaves or whole plant. Let me use remaining 2 views to confirm.
Strong match - Anthracnose reference shows extensive dark brown/black spots on banana fruit peel, exactly matching the lesion pattern in the test image's "Moldy" and "Highly moldy" groups.

Perfect confirmation. This Anthracnose reference shows a banana fruit with large dark circular lesions on yellow peel - identical to the test image's Day 5-7 appearance (dark circular spots on banana fruit body).

**Analysis summary:**
- Test image: banana fruits with dark circular lesions expanding over time post-inoculation
- Anthracnose: dark brown/black circular spots on banana fruit peel - **exact visual match**
- All other classes (Bunchy_Top, Cordana_Leaf_Spot, Panama_Disease, Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka) affect leaves/whole plant, not fruit
- Cigar_End_Rot affects the fruit tip only, not the body
